notes:
Agent loop SA-1: host security audit wired into the recommendation review loop (docs/326).

New migration 055: agent_security_audit_requests (one open request per site/environment, append-only, terminal states immutable) and agent_security_audit_runs (immutable: UPDATE and DELETE rejected by trigger). Both tables are forced-RLS; the machine endpoints write only through a site token, and the platform recomputes the summary from findings rather than trusting the host's own summary.

Machine side: POST /api/agent-executions/security-audits/claim and /{id}/result. The host claims at most one queued audit, runs the read-only check, and reports either a completed audit or one of six closed-set failure codes. Platform rejection (422) is terminal and carries the reason. Session side: GET /api/agent-security-audits (overview: latest run, per-item change from the previous run, history, open request, last failure, open remediations, capability flags), POST /api/agent-security-audits/requests (immediate re-check, deduplicated while one is open), POST /api/agent-requests/from-security-finding (admin only, latest run only, remediable items only).

Remediation is a deterministic, non-model candidate: plan and the single manual action are built server-side from the finding and the fixed route guides in shared-types (no AI call, no hash drift when guide text changes). /generate regenerates that candidate with a new action identity and revision, so a review request that comes back as refining cannot get stuck. Model candidate writes, machine preparation, candidate inline edits, remaining-item revision and in-platform restore all answer 409; rollback is performed by the person and verified by the next audit.

Verification: after a manually delivered report is accepted, the platform asks for a new audit and only counts a run claimed after acceptance. pass -> verified; fail/warn -> failed; unknown/skipped/missing finding in that run -> unavailable (missing data is never treated as pass, 铁律一). While waiting, no thread message is posted and the execution stays pending.

Web: /recommendations/security shows the latest run, the per-item diff, three groups (needs fixing / not measured / passed), re-check, remediation per item, and history. Security plans and actions are rendered by dedicated blocks so the generic wording does not claim a field write or an in-platform restore; out-of-band tier labels distinguish 'manual patch' from 'manual remediation' (the platform produces no patch for these items). Three BFF routes added and the Caddy templates now route /api/agent-security-audits through the Web BFF like the other session routes.

Rollback uses v0.2.34 application images; schema 055 is additive only (new tables, new enum values; no ALTER on existing rows). Validation HEAD: PostgreSQL 16 migration 001-055 twice plus eight suites passed 184/0, API 2374/0, workspace typecheck and build passed, BFF routing 133 checks passed across the three Caddy templates, synthetic security-audit browser run 72 checks passed (0 real AI calls, 0 site writes, 0 host writes), history 173/173 open. No production WordPress writes, no real host audit and no timer installation in this release; production enablement stays a separate, user-approved step (SA-3).
